newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran leader congratulates new moderate president.
newsitem.headline: Iran leader congratulates new moderate president.

text.p: Iran's supreme leader on Saturday congratulated moderate former culture minister Mohammad Khatami on his landslide victory in the country's presidential election and called on the other candidates and their supporters to back the new president, state-run Tehran radio said.

In a message read on the radio, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei also praised the high turnout in Friday's polls to replace President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani, and said "this huge popular mobilisation would not have taken place without the presence of a variety of tastes and temperaments among the candidates".
